ticker: L&T secures $1.57B AI data centre order
Sukhbir Singh Badal attacked in Nanded
BofA to acquire 49.9% stake in Jio Credit
Turkey plans defense pact with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia

articles.headline: L&T Secures $1.57 Billion AI Data Centre Order
articles.brief: Larsen and Toubro has secured a major order worth up to $1.57 billion to build advanced AI data centres, marking a massive leap for India's digital infrastructure growth.

articles.headline: Google DeepMind Faces Leadership Overhaul as Hassabis Exits
articles.whyItMatters: Signals a strategic shift in global AI development.
articles.brief: Demis Hassabis has stepped aside as CEO of Google DeepMind amid leadership changes as co-founder Sergey Brin urges the team to accelerate development on Gemini.

articles.headline: BofA Takes 49.9% Stake in Jio Credit for $1.9B
articles.whyItMatters: Deepens foreign institutional investment in Indian fintech.
articles.brief: Bank of America is set to acquire a 49.9% stake in Jio Credit for $1.9 billion, marking a major strategic push into India's expanding financial sector.

articles.headline: Indian Bank Deposits Jump by $115 Billion
articles.whyItMatters: Reflects shifting liquidity trends across domestic markets.
articles.brief: Deposits in Indian banks have surged by $115 billion over three fortnights, reaching a record high driven by macroeconomic shifts and changing saver behavior.

articles.headline: Turkey Proposes Defense Pact with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia
articles.whyItMatters: Could redraw regional security alliances across West and South Asia.
articles.brief: Turkey has laid out comprehensive plans for a new trilateral defense pact involving Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, aiming to boost military cooperation and strategic ties.

articles.headline: BNP Nominates Mirza Fakhrul for Bangladesh Presidential Poll
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights ongoing political realignments in South Asia.
articles.brief: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party has officially nominated stalwart leader Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as its candidate for the upcoming presidential elections.

articles.headline: Indian IT Sector Shifts Focus Toward High-Value Skills
articles.whyItMatters: Signals the end of broad-based hiring and low-skill recruitment.
articles.brief: Industry experts note that mass hiring models in Indian IT are ending, with companies tightening entry-level intake while paying premiums for specialized experience.

articles.headline: Lenovo Posts 43% Q1 Revenue Jump on AI Boom
articles.whyItMatters: Demonstrates commercial viability of enterprise infrastructure investments.
articles.brief: China's Lenovo reported a 43% surge in first-quarter revenue, successfully capitalizing on the global surge in demand for hardware supporting AI infrastructure.

articles.headline: Sukhbir Singh Badal Attacked at Nanded Gurdwara
articles.whyItMatters: Raises serious concerns regarding high-profile political security.
articles.brief: Shiromani Akali Dal president Sukhbir Singh Badal survived an assault involving a kirpan during a religious visit in Nanded, prompting immediate security reviews.

articles.headline: Karnataka Launches Tathyakosh.in Public Data Platform
articles.whyItMatters: Enhances open data discovery for researchers and policymakers.
articles.brief: The Karnataka government has launched Tathyakosh.in, a centralized public data discovery platform designed to streamline dataset access for developers and startups.

articles.headline: Air India Expands Pilot Drug Testing After Marijuana Case
articles.whyItMatters: Imposes stricter safety and compliance standards in aviation.
articles.brief: Following a positive marijuana test from a captain, Air India has expanded mandatory drug screening protocols to encompass all active flight crew members.

articles.headline: India Prepares for Crucial Cricket Series in Sri Lanka
articles.whyItMatters: Draws immense global attention from sports enthusiasts.
articles.brief: The Indian national cricket team has intensified its training regimen ahead of the first Test match in Galle, focusing heavily on ambidextrous catching drills.

articles.headline: Harbhajan Singh Open to Reconciliation with Sreesanth
articles.whyItMatters: Resolves a long-standing rivalry within Indian cricket lore.
articles.brief: Former Indian spinner Harbhajan Singh expressed willingness to mend fences with Sreesanth, suggesting a joint roommate arrangement could clear past tensions.

articles.headline: UNSC Attributes 2025 Red Fort Blast to Al-Qaeda
articles.whyItMatters: Confirms evolving regional security threats across South Asia.
articles.brief: A newly released UN Security Council report officially links the 2025 Red Fort blast to the Al-Qaeda in the Indian Subcontinent network, warning of decentralized operations.

articles.headline: NASA Explores Deep Space Collaboration with India
articles.whyItMatters: Expands international partnerships in lunar exploration.
articles.brief: NASA has outlined details of its Moon Base programme, inviting India to join the ambitious southern pole outpost initiative slated for development over the coming decade.
